subject: resource_control: introduce privilege RESOURCE_GROUP_USER to restrict the switch of resource group (#53483)
summary: Reviewed planner/privilege changes in this commit vs parent: adds dynamic privilege `RESOURCE_GROUP_USER`, enforces privilege checks for `SET RESOURCE GROUP` via planner visitInfo, and gates `/*+ RESOURCE_GROUP(...) */` hint application in `planner.Optimize` (ignore + warning when missing privilege). No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/privilege-boundary issues found in the touched planner/privilege paths.
